# apple_subscription_retention_message (Resource)

Assigns a retention message to an auto-renewable subscription. A subscription has at most one retention message, so use one of these resources per subscription: assigning a message replaces the one the subscription had. App Store Connect can't unassign a message, so destroying the resource only removes it from the Terraform state; deleting the retention message unassigns it. Import it with the subscription's ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_retention_message" "monthly" {
  subscription_id      = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  retention_message_id = apple_retention_message.stay.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `retention_message_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a retention message of the subscription's app, e.g. `apple_retention_message.example.id`.
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_retention_message.monthly
  identity = {
    subscription_id = "6446452616"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <subscription_id>
terraform import apple_subscription_retention_message.monthly 6446452616
```
